index::* sourcetype="microsoft:userRegistrationDetails" userPrincipalName="*"
| dedup userPrincipalName 
| stats count as Count by userType

index::* sourcetype="microsoft:userRegistrationDetails" userPrincipalName="*" 
| dedup userPrincipalName 
| mvexpand methodsRegistered{} 
| rename methodsRegistered{} as methodsRegistered 
| eval "methodsRegistered" = case(methodsRegistered="microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "Authenticator – Push", methodsRegistered="email", "Email Verification",methodsRegistered="macOsSecureEnclaveKey", "macOS Secure Enclave",methodsRegistered="microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "Authenticator – Push",methodsRegistered="alternateMobilePhone", "Alternate Mobile"
    ,methodsRegistered="mobilePhone", "Mobile Phone (SMS/Call)",methodsRegistered="officePhone", "Office Phone",methodsRegistered="passKeyDeviceBound", "Passkey (Device‑Bound)",methodsRegistered="passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator", "Passkey Authenticator",methodsRegistered="softwareOneTimePasscode", "Software OTP (TOTP App)",methodsRegistered="windowsHelloForBusiness", "Windows Hello for Business",1=1, methodsRegistered) 
| search methodsRegistered!="" 
| stats count as "User Count" by methodsRegistered 
| transpose 0 header_field=methodsRegistered 
| rename column as "Method Registered"
| eval "Method Registered" = ""
